verdict.rationale: Modal's pricing docs and marketing explicitly state per-second billing with no reserved capacity ('pay by the second with no reserved capacity', 'only pay for what you use', 'burst up to what you need without over-allocating'), and this is corroborated by a community user who built self-hosted runners specifically to 'pay for what you need only.' missing for 10: an independent/third-party billing audit or detailed rate-card breakdown showing exact second-level granularity in an invoice.
